conditions: Special relativity; relative speed is nonnegative and strictly below the vacuum speed of light.
spoken_aliases: gamma equals one divided by the square root of the quantity one minus v squared divided by c squared
the lorentz factor equals the reciprocal of the square root of open parenthesis one minus the fraction with numerator v squared and denominator c squared close parenthesis

evidence: For an inertial timelike worldline, the invariant proper-time increment satisfies c^2 d tau^2=c^2 dt^2-|d x|^2. With speed v=|d x|/dt this gives d tau=dt sqrt(1-v^2/c^2). The positive ratio dt/d tau is the Lorentz factor.
